notes.title: Development Update #3 - New Co-Founder, Draft!
notes.content:
Well hi there, everyone! For those of you in the US or elsewhere that had a long weekend, I hope you enjoyed it! I know I sure did - I needed a reset. 

I have a couple fun announcements to share. 

1. Please join me in welcoming Nathan Edmonds as our new Co-founder and Chief Marketing Officer! We're so excited to have his years of experience and expertise to help us reach a global audience as we ramp up our marketing efforts into and through the fall. Welcome Nathan!!

2. From a dev side - we're hard at work and remain on track. Our early internal playtests have been incredible to keep "finding the fun" wherever we can, which has added changes including a full pro style draft system, patch/meta shifts, tons of in-game "champs" or "heroes," and much more. I can't wait to share it all with you soon. 

And that's it! My goal for these is to continue to let you know hey, we're here, we're hard at work. More visuals to come as our incredible art and graphics team finishes their parts, but for now you'll have to settle for a text preview of what's in my code :) 

Enjoy your week, and make sure you keep telling your friends - ETM is coming in Q4!
